description: This file defines the ResumeSourceBuilder class, a builder for creating a resumable Akka stream source with configurable backoff, restart, and error handling policies.

classes.name: ResumeSourceBuilder
classes.description: A generic builder class for constructing a resumable Akka stream source with configurable parameters such as backoff durations, restart limits, seed functions, and error mapping.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the resume source using the configured parameters, ensuring all required fields are non-null.

methods.name: minBackoff
methods.description: Sets the minimum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxBackoff
methods.description: Sets the maximum backoff duration after a recoverable error.

methods.name: maxRestarts
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of restart attempts before failing the stream; negative for unlimited.

methods.name: recovery
methods.description: Sets the recovery period after which the backoff is reset if no errors occur.

methods.name: initialSeed
methods.description: Sets the initial seed value to start the stream.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Sets the function to create or resume a stream from a seed.

methods.name: lookBehind
methods.description: Sets how many elements to keep for resumption.

methods.name: nextSeed
methods.description: Sets the function to compute the next seed from the last N elements.

methods.name: mapError
methods.description: Sets the function to map recoverable errors to Optional.empty() and unrecoverable errors to a Throwable to fail the source.
